For many he can be a fool, but as his wife says "those who call lord Caur fool can not understand his kindness and virtues".

[b]Mama Cajén[/b]
 [i]"No matter who you are, i will not allow you hurt my family or people"[/i]

She is also responsible for training and teaching the Awi, on matters of culture and combat.
'[i]Show no mercy to your opponent, even if he is your own mother, my son"[/i]
